chapters.title: Meet Otto
captions: Your agents. Your repos. Your data. Your infrastructure.
Otto: every coding agent, one native Mac app.

chapters.title: Home
captions: Home shows live sessions, dashboards, usage and findings.
Light, dark and right-to-left, one design system.

chapters.title: The command bar
captions: Press ⌘K, type or speak. Otto runs it or answers.
⌥Space calls the bar from anywhere on your Mac.

chapters.title: Agents
captions: Agents is one workspace: your sessions in an inbox beside the canvas, status in words.
Switch a session between Terminal and Chat, tile it with the rest, or broadcast one prompt to many.

chapters.title: Threads
captions: Threads run every structured agent: Claude, Codex, Antigravity, OpenCode, pi, Gemini, Grok and Muse.
Plans, commands and diffs stream live. Approve inline, or compare models side by side.

chapters.title: Workflows
captions: Workflows opens on Runs: what needs you, what is running and what just finished, in words.
A run page lists every step in order. A review fans out to twelve named reviewers, each with its own conversation.
A failed run leads with the step's own error and Retry step, on your Mac or your phone.
Pick each step’s model and effort, as in Threads.
A goal is a workflow too: it works until every criterion is checked and met.
Optimize drafts a faster version; you apply it.

chapters.title: Personal Agents
captions: A personal agent's Chat is a thread on the same runtime, with its tools and routines.
Scheduled tasks run agents on a cadence and report back.

chapters.title: IDE (Beta)
captions: The IDE keeps your projects in the order you added them, and brings back every tab after a restart.
Type with the language server beside you, run a test configuration and see the results.
Debug with breakpoints, frames and variables, or ask the agent about the selected code.

chapters.title: Debug with an agent
captions: Ask an agent to debug with Otto. Before anything runs, you see exactly what it will start.
Its breakpoints are marked as its own. At every stop it says what the values show, and waits.
Press Proceed to let it go on, or use the debugger yourself to take over.

chapters.title: DB Watch
captions: DB Watch shows the rows your code wrote at every stop: changed cells only, before → after.

chapters.title: Git and AI review
captions: Git opens on History. Your uncommitted changes are its top row.
Stage, commit and draft the message there. Multi-agent review turns findings into tracked fixes.

chapters.title: Product and Design Hall
captions: A story's Design tab lists the designs that implement it.
Design Hall is the one home for designs: versions, compare, approve, and comments pinned on the design.

chapters.title: Vault and Skills Lab
captions: The Vault links your docs with backlinks. Skills Lab is the one home for agent skills.

chapters.title: Database Explorer
captions: Query MySQL, Postgres, MongoDB, Redis and ClickHouse.
A read-only connection refuses writes. History spans every connection.

chapters.title: Connections and cloud
captions: SSH, AWS, Kubernetes, APIs and the web.
An MCP server that runs through Otto can be available in every workspace, with one set of credentials.

chapters.title: Insights and Usage
captions: Insights turns your activity into key findings.
Usage shows what is left on each plan, per login.

chapters.title: Rooms · collaborate and recap
captions: Start a room from a live session. The host admits who joins.
Share a screen and talk it through.
Teammates draw on the shared screen, with permission.
Hand over terminal control, and take it back at any time.
With everyone's consent, get a local recap: decisions and action items.

chapters.title: Phone access
captions: Continue on phone: scan, approve the match on your Mac, and the thread opens.
Or switch the phone to the light version: five tabs, one tap back.

chapters.title: Updates
captions: Check for Updates… shows what is new and downloads the new version.
Restart to finish: Otto lists what keeps running first.

chapters.title: Everywhere
captions: Snip the screen, bridge Slack and Telegram, and take Otto with you.
Otto. All your agents, one home.
